addr: 3rd and 4th floor, 25, Brigade Rd, above Levi’s showroom, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Toca Brigade and Terrace is a great spot if you’re looking for both party vibes and a relaxed dining experience in one place. The venue is spread across two floors, which makes it stand out—on the first floor, you have a lively club setup …

The ambience is good. Desi Punjabi music for ones who enjoy it.
The service is extremely slow. Our drinks arrived after 40 mins when all starters were over. …

Reel vs reality  .Expected much better based on the reviews. The food lacked flavor. We have ordered butter garlic prawn and chili chicken. It was pathetic. In chili chicken the chicken pieces are don't know how many days old it was. …
